name: TDXdown
impact: Untrusted VMM single-steps and counts instructions executed inside an Intel TDX trust domain, defeating the single-stepping countermeasure to trace guest execution
mitigation: Intel TDX module 1.5.06 fixes the single-stepping heuristic; no countermeasure shipped against StumbleStepping instruction counting
boundary_statement: TDXdown (CCS 2024, University of Lubeck; Intel INTEL-2024-10-08-001 / INTEL-SA-01099) single-steps and counts instructions in an Intel TDX trust domain from the VMM. Intel rates it low (CVSS 2.5) and fixed the single-stepping heuristic in TDX module 1.5.06; StumbleStepping instruction counting is unmitigated.

Intel-TDX.evidence: Project site: 'Intel has mitigated the vulnerability in the single-stepping heuristic starting with TDX module version 1.5.06. However, they will not provide countermeasures against StumbleStepping.'
